body.p:
If internal Graphics is to be disabled, the BIOS must perform the following steps:
Set the GMS field of the GMCH Graphics Control Register D0.F0.R050h [15:8] =‘00000b’. This prevents UMA memory from being pre-allocated to the internal Graphics Device.
Set the GGMS field of the GMCH Graphics Control Register D0.F0.R050h [7:6] =‘00000000b’.
Set the internal Graphics Device VGA Disable (IVD) field of the GMCH Graphics Control Register D0.F0.R050h [1] = ‘1b’. This will prevent the internal Graphics Device from claiming VGA cycles.
Program D0.F0.R054h [4] = 0b to disable internal graphics device.
